posts.text: Intertek cut its annual dividend 34.5%, from £1.65 to £1.08. This follows 8.6% 5-year dividend growth.
Allwyn AG raised its annual dividend 40%, from €0.50 to €0.70. This was seen on Oct 23.
PAX Global cut its annual dividend 75.8%, from HK$0.33 to HK$0.08.
West Pharmaceutical Services raised its annual dividend 18.2%, from $0.88 to $1.04. The company has a 28-year increase streak.
Texas Instruments raised its annual dividend 7.0%, from $5.68 to $6.08. This was seen on Oct 16.
Microsoft raised its annual dividend 7.7%, from $3.64 to $3.92. The company has a 15-year increase streak.
Nike yields 4.37%, 3.1 times its 5-year average of 1.41%. The company has a 23-year increase streak.
Domino's Pizza yields 2.55%, 2.06 times its 5-year average of 1.24%. The company has a 12-year increase streak.
